title: Ordinary strictly perfect evaluation is degreewise invertible
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $P,F$ complexes of sheaves of $\mathcal O_U$-modules, with $P$ strictly perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Put $S=\mathcal O_U[0]$ and $D=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,S)$ [def-pur-hom-complex]. Let $f:\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes D)\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,F)$ be a chain map [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Require that on the tensor summand $F^p\otimes D^q$ in degree $n=p+q$, its projection to $\mathcal Hom(P^r,F^{r+n})$ is zero if $r+q\ne0$; if $r+q=0$, it is the currying of evaluation of $D^q$ on $P^r$, followed by the unit action on $F^p$ [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Then every $f^n$ is an isomorphism. No boundedness is required of $F$ and $U$ need not be affine.
